title: Beacon Signal Burst — Set 1401
statement: A field beacon records integer signal readings in time order. A reading is clear when it is at least threshold. Among all contiguous blocks of exactly width readings, return the largest number of clear readings. Return a count, not a sum or the block position. The input is one object { readings, width, threshold }.
constraints: Readings and threshold are integers from -20 through 20.

examples.explanation: For {"readings":[4,-1,6,5],"width":2,"threshold":4}, the result is 2. Count the first block, then update its count using the one departing and one arriving reading. Track the largest count.
For {"readings":[2,2,1],"width":3,"threshold":2}, the result is 2. Count the first block, then update its count using the one departing and one arriving reading. Track the largest count.

hints.content: Convert each reading mentally to clear or not clear.
Consecutive candidate blocks overlap in all but two positions.
Count clear readings in the first complete block.
Remove the departing reading's contribution and add the arriving reading's contribution.
Record the maximum after each shift, including the initial block.

For {"readings":[-6,-17,1,-16,-14,-11,-14,-12,-18,-1,-14],"width":3,"threshold":-5}, the result is 1. Checked by independent enumeration and the optimized reference.
For {"readings":[1,-9,4,8,-19,10,-18,-4,9,-1,-11,6,-9],"width":1,"threshold":20}, the result is 0. Checked by independent enumeration and the optimized reference.
For {"readings":[-6,19,18,9,-4,7,12,8,14],"width":5,"threshold":-2}, the result is 4. Checked by independent enumeration and the optimized reference.
For {"readings":[3,-13,17,-9,16,4,4,3,11],"width":6,"threshold":1}, the result is 5. Checked by independent enumeration and the optimized reference.

solutions.title: Enumerate the candidates
solutions.intuition: Enumerating all allowed choices gives a small-input correctness oracle.
solutions.approach: For every complete block, inspect its width readings and count those at least the threshold.
solutions.pseudocode: For every complete block, inspect its width readings and count those at least the threshold.
commonMistakes: Summing readings instead of counting qualifying readings.
